تتقارضي (form VI)
# تَتَقَارَضِي (tataqāraḍī) /ta.ta.qaː.ra.dˤiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَقَارَضَ (taqāraḍa)
# تُتَقَارَضِي (tutaqāraḍī) /tu.ta.qaː.ra.dˤiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَقَارَضَ (taqāraḍa)
